sources.name: MoleculeNet BBBP (Martins et al. 2012)
sources.license: Not stated in the CSV file itself. DeepChem/MoleculeNet ships BBBP without a per-file LICENSE; upstream is Martins et al. 2012 (Scientific Data 3:160117).
sources.subjects_or_units: 2050 compounds. No human/ animal subjects; no participants. Unit of the measured quantity: NONE (binary class label p_np in {0,1}).
sources.frame: not_applicable (molecular record, no tissue or coordinate frame)
sources.form_check: records=2050, published count 2050, count_verified=true, p_np distribution {1:1567, 0:483}
sources.constrains_rationale: Frozen PREREG rule: a binary classification without a substrate-specific measured magnitude may not be called constraining. BBBP carries no magnitude for glucose and contains no glucose entry.

sources.name: B3DB regression set (theochem/B3DB, CC0)
sources.license: CC0 1.0 Universal (full legal code downloaded to samples/theochem_B3DB_LICENSE.txt; licence statement at README line 136)
sources.subjects_or_units: 1058 compounds with numerical logBB. logBB is dimensionless: log10(C_brain / C_blood).
sources.parameter_or_output: Measured log10 brain-to-blood concentration ratio per compound.
sources.frame: reference frame = brain tissue vs blood, same species. No coordinate frame (non-spatial dataset).
sources.form_check: records=1058 vs README-stated 1058 -> count_verified=true; logBB n=1058, min -2.69, max 1.70, mean -0.0779, median -0.02

sources.constrains_rationale: This is the only open logBB dataset retrieved, and it contains no D-glucose. Per the frozen counter-check in PREREG.md, H1 may not be scored on it.
order_only: H1 (passive logBB ~ 0 for small polar solutes) as a population prior only

sources.name: ChEMBL bioactivities, human SLC2A1 / GLUT1 (CHEMBL2535)
sources.license: ChEMBL data is released under CC BY-SA 3.0 (EMBL-EBI terms of use).
sources.subjects_or_units: 829 activity records. Units nM throughout (mol/L = nM x 1e-9). Measured range 0.3 - 100000 nM = 3e-10 - 1e-4 mol/L. Standard types: IC50, Ki, Kd. No human participants (in vitro / heterologous expression).
sources.parameter_or_output: Measured IC50/Ki/Kd against GLUT1 for non-glucose substrates.
sources.frame: reference frame = in vitro assay system and substrate identity; not a tissue frame.
sources.target_id_provenance: UniProt P11166 (gene_exact:SLC2A1, reviewed, Homo sapiens) -> ChEMBL target_components__accession=P11166 -> CHEMBL2535. No guessed accession.
sources.constrains_rationale: No D-glucose substrate record exists in this target slice; the model parameter km_luminal_in_mM = 1.5 is therefore NOT measured by this source.

sources.name: ChEMBL: D-glucose vs the four transporter targets (decisive negative query)
sources.license: ChEMBL data, CC BY-SA 3.0 (EMBL-EBI terms of use).
sources.subjects_or_units: 13 ChEMBL molecules whose pref_name contains 'glucose' (incl. beta-D-Glucose CHEMBL1614854, 2-deoxy-D-glucose CHEMBL1880349, levoglucose CHEMBL1873035). Zero activity records exist against the four targets.
sources.parameter_or_output: Count of measured glucose-transporter affinities. Measured value: 0 records.
sources.contains_d_glucose: n/a (this query IS the glucose query)
sources.constrains_rationale: This source establishes a NEGATIVE result: it constrains what open data CANNOT do. It shows km_luminal_in_mM, vmax_luminal_efflux_umol_min and ki_comp_mM are not measurable from these public databases for D-glucose.
sources.methodological_note: An earlier probe used molecule_structures__canonical_smiles__icontains=glucose and returned 0 molecules. That probe was INVALID (the D-glucose canonical SMILES contains no literal substring 'glucose') and was discarded rather than reported as a negative result. The negative is instead based on a pref_name search returning 13 real glucose molecules, so absence of activity is a genuine zero and not a search artefact.

sources.name: Human Protein Atlas: RNA single cell type (pan-tissue snRNA-seq panel)
sources.license: Human Protein Atlas data is released under CC BY-SA 4.0 (HPA terms of use).
sources.format: ZIP containing one TSV, 4 columns (Gene, Gene name, Cell type, nCPM), 3087080 data rows
sources.subjects_or_units: Human post-mortem tissue single-cell RNA-seq, aggregated to 154 named cell types per queried gene. No participants count published with this file. Unit: nCPM (normalised counts per million) - NOT nTPM.
sources.parameter_or_output: Measured transcript abundance per cell type. vascular endothelial cells: SLC2A3 769.0, ABCB1 507.4, SLC2A1 78.8, ABCC1 16.3 nCPM.
sources.frame: reference frame = pan-tissue single-cell cell-type panel. This is NOT brain-capillary endothelium. Declared explicitly so the number is not misread as a BBB measurement.
sources.form_check: archive opens, header verified, 3087080 data rows parsed, 154 cell types matched per gene
sources.id_provenance: ENSG IDs resolved live via Ensembl REST symbol lookup (SLC2A1 ENSG00000117394, SLC2A3 ENSG00000059804, ABCC1 ENSG00000103222, ABCB1 ENSG00000085563). Not guessed.
sources.constrains_rationale: Unit frame is wrong for the BBB question and no brain-endothelium compartment exists in this panel, so it cannot set vmax or km. It can only order transporter vs pump abundance.

sources.name: Human Protein Atlas per-gene JSON + summary TSV (four genes)
sources.format: JSON (per-gene) and TSV (summary), 4 files, 178-243 B each
sources.subjects_or_units: Qualitative specificity/distribution plus ONLY the tissues in which the gene is enriched. Unit: qualitative, plus a sparse 'RNA tissue specific nTPM' field.
sources.parameter_or_output: SLC2A1 'Tissue enhanced / Detected in many'; SLC2A3 'Tissue enhanced / Detected in all'; ABCC1 'Low tissue specificity / Detected in many'; ABCB1 'Tissue enhanced / Detected in many'.
sources.form_check: all four files HTTP 200, parsed, 1 record each
sources.limitation: The per-gene payload is SPARSE BY DESIGN: 'RNA tissue specific nTPM' returns 0-2 tissues per gene, so it cannot supply a whole-panel brain nTPM. Recorded as a form finding, not a measurement.

sources.name: UniProtKB REST: accession resolution for the four genes
sources.subjects_or_units: 4 files, 611-1062 B. Reviewed human entries only.
sources.role: Identity provenance only: prevents guessed accessions from silently corrupting the ChEMBL and HPA joins.
